subject: storm damage and power cuts
source: A violent storm swept across the region overnight, bringing down trees and power lines. More than forty thousand homes were left without electricity. Several roads were blocked and train services were suspended for the morning. Emergency crews worked through the night to restore power. Most customers should be reconnected by the evening.
translation: Une violente tempête a balayé la région pendant la nuit, abattant des arbres et des lignes électriques. Plus de quarante mille foyers ont été privés d'électricité. Plusieurs routes ont été bloquées et le trafic ferroviaire a été suspendu dans la matinée. Les équipes d'intervention ont travaillé toute la nuit pour rétablir le courant. La plupart des clients devraient être reconnectés d'ici le soir.
paraphrase: Overnight, a fierce storm hit the region, knocking down trees and power cables. Over forty thousand households lost their electricity supply. Trains were cancelled for the morning and a number of roads were closed. Repair teams spent the whole night working to bring power back. By this evening, most customers are expected to have electricity again.
independent_same: Insurers expect thousands of claims after the storm, mainly for damaged roofs and fallen trees. They advise policyholders to take photographs before any repair. Builders are already overwhelmed with requests. Some residents have been offered temporary tarpaulins by the council. The government is considering a special support fund.
independent_other: Le gestionnaire du réseau électrique va enterrer cent kilomètres de lignes aériennes d'ici cinq ans. L'objectif est de réduire les coupures lors des tempêtes. Les travaux concerneront en priorité les zones boisées. Les riverains seront informés avant chaque chantier. Le coût sera intégré dans les tarifs de distribution.

subject: new public swimming lake
source: A former gravel pit will be turned into a public swimming lake by next summer. The site will include a sandy beach, changing rooms and a lifeguard station. Water quality will be tested every week during the season. Entry will be free for residents of the municipality. The project also creates a protected area for birds on the opposite shore.
translation: Une ancienne gravière sera transformée en lac de baignade public d'ici l'été prochain. Le site comprendra une plage de sable, des vestiaires et un poste de surveillance. La qualité de l'eau sera contrôlée chaque semaine pendant la saison. L'entrée sera gratuite pour les habitants de la commune. Le projet crée aussi une zone protégée pour les oiseaux sur la rive opposée.
paraphrase: By next summer, an old gravel pit will have become a public lake where people can swim. A sandy beach, changing facilities and a lifeguard post are planned. During the season, the water will be checked every week. Residents of the municipality will not have to pay to get in. On the far bank, the project will also set aside a protected zone for birds.
independent_same: Several beaches on the coast were closed this week because of high bacteria levels in the water. Authorities blame heavy rain that overwhelmed sewage systems. Swimmers are advised to check the daily water quality map. Lifeguards have placed red flags on the affected beaches. Tests will be repeated until levels fall.
independent_other: Les communes riveraines du lac s'accordent pour limiter le nombre de bateaux à moteur. Les embarcations électriques et les voiliers resteront autorisés. La mesure vise à réduire le bruit et la pollution de l'eau. Les loueurs de bateaux demandent une période de transition. Un comptage des usagers sera réalisé cet été.

subject: teenage mental health service
source: A new mental health service for teenagers has opened in the town centre. Young people aged twelve to eighteen can visit without an appointment. Psychologists and youth workers offer free and confidential support. The service was created after a sharp rise in requests from schools. It will be open four afternoons a week, including Saturday.
translation: Un nouveau service de santé mentale pour adolescents a ouvert ses portes au centre-ville. Les jeunes de douze à dix-huit ans peuvent s'y rendre sans rendez-vous. Des psychologues et des éducateurs y proposent un soutien gratuit et confidentiel. Le service a été créé après une forte hausse des demandes venant des écoles. Il sera ouvert quatre après-midi par semaine, samedi compris.
paraphrase: In the town centre, a mental health service aimed at teenagers has just opened. Twelve- to eighteen-year-olds can drop in without booking. Support from psychologists and youth workers is free of charge and confidential. Schools had been sending far more requests, which led to the service being set up. Opening hours cover four afternoons each week, Saturday included.
independent_same: Schools are training teachers to recognise early signs of anxiety and depression in pupils. The programme includes a two-day course and regular follow-up sessions. Teachers say they feel more confident discussing emotional problems. Parents can also attend evening workshops. The education ministry plans to extend the programme nationwide.
independent_other: Une ligne d'écoute pour étudiants enregistre un nombre record d'appels en période d'examens. Les bénévoles constatent beaucoup de stress et de solitude. La ligne est ouverte tous les soirs jusqu'à minuit. Les universités financent une partie de son fonctionnement. Un service de discussion en ligne sera ajouté.

subject: factory expansion and jobs
source: A bicycle manufacturer will double the size of its factory and hire two hundred workers. The company says demand for electric bikes has grown strongly across Europe. The expansion will be built on land next to the existing plant. Training programmes will be offered to unemployed people in the area. Production in the new hall should start in two years.
translation: Un fabricant de vélos va doubler la taille de son usine et embaucher deux cents travailleurs. L'entreprise explique que la demande de vélos électriques a fortement augmenté dans toute l'Europe. L'extension sera construite sur un terrain voisin de l'usine actuelle. Des formations seront proposées aux demandeurs d'emploi de la région. La production dans le nouveau hall devrait démarrer dans deux ans.
paraphrase: Two hundred new jobs will be created as a bicycle maker doubles the size of its factory. Across Europe, electric bikes are selling much better, the firm says. The new facility will stand on a plot beside the current plant. Jobseekers in the area will be offered training. In two years' time, the new hall should begin producing bikes.
independent_same: Unemployment in the region fell to its lowest level in fifteen years last quarter. Construction and healthcare recorded the strongest job growth. Employers still report difficulty finding qualified technicians. The employment agency is expanding evening courses. Youth unemployment, however, remains above the national average.
independent_other: Une entreprise de logistique annonce la suppression de quatre-vingts emplois à la suite de l'automatisation de son entrepôt. Les syndicats demandent des reclassements internes. La direction promet des formations aux nouveaux métiers de maintenance. Les premiers départs auront lieu au printemps. Les autorités régionales suivent le dossier.

subject: museum free entry
source: All municipal museums will offer free entry on the first Sunday of every month from January. The council hopes to attract families and people who rarely visit museums. Guided tours and children's workshops will be organised on those days. The loss of ticket revenue will be partly offset by sponsorship. Attendance figures will be published after one year.
translation: Tous les musées communaux proposeront l'entrée gratuite le premier dimanche de chaque mois à partir de janvier. Le conseil espère attirer les familles et les personnes qui visitent rarement les musées. Des visites guidées et des ateliers pour enfants seront organisés ces jours-là. La perte de recettes de billetterie sera en partie compensée par du mécénat. Les chiffres de fréquentation seront publiés après un an.
paraphrase: From January, entry to every municipal museum will be free on the first Sunday of each month. The council wants to bring in families and people who seldom go to museums. On those Sundays, there will be guided tours and workshops for children. Sponsorship will make up for some of the lost ticket income. Visitor numbers will be made public after twelve months.
independent_same: The art museum has acquired a painting by a local artist from the nineteenth century. The work was bought at auction with the help of a private foundation. It shows the town's harbour at sunset. Restorers will clean the painting before it goes on display. A special exhibition about the artist is planned for next year.
independent_other: Les musées de la région accueillent de plus en plus de visiteurs grâce aux applications de visite sur téléphone. Les applications proposent des commentaires audio et des jeux pour enfants. Certains visiteurs regrettent toutefois la disparition des guides humains. Les musées assurent que les visites guidées restent disponibles. Une enquête de satisfaction est en cours.

subject: speed cameras in residential streets
source: Twenty new speed cameras will be installed in residential streets across the city. The speed limit in these areas has recently been reduced to thirty kilometres per hour. Police say many drivers still ignore the new limit. Revenue from fines will be used to improve road safety around schools. The first cameras will be operational next month.
translation: Vingt nouveaux radars seront installés dans des rues résidentielles de la ville. La vitesse dans ces quartiers a récemment été limitée à trente kilomètres par heure. Selon la police, de nombreux conducteurs ignorent encore la nouvelle limite. Les recettes des amendes serviront à améliorer la sécurité routière autour des écoles. Les premiers radars seront opérationnels le mois prochain.
paraphrase: Across the city, residential streets will get twenty extra speed cameras. The limit there was lowered not long ago to thirty kilometres an hour. Plenty of motorists are still not respecting it, according to the police. Money collected from fines will go towards safer roads near schools. Next month, the first of the cameras will start working.
independent_same: Road deaths fell slightly last year, but the number of injured cyclists rose. Most accidents happened at junctions in urban areas. The road safety institute recommends more protected crossings. It also calls for better lighting on rural roads. A national awareness campaign will begin in autumn.
independent_other: Les parents d'élèves d'une école primaire ont obtenu la fermeture de leur rue à la circulation aux heures d'entrée et de sortie. Des barrières sont installées par des bénévoles chaque matin. Les enfants peuvent ainsi arriver à pied ou à vélo en sécurité. Les riverains ont été consultés avant l'essai. D'autres écoles souhaitent suivre l'exemple.

subject: rural broadband rollout
source: Fibre broadband will reach every village in the province by the end of next year, the telecom operator says. The rollout is supported by a public subsidy of forty million. More than ten thousand homes still have very slow connections. Residents will be able to choose between several internet providers on the new network. Works in the streets will be announced village by village.
translation: La fibre optique atteindra tous les villages de la province d'ici la fin de l'année prochaine, selon l'opérateur télécom. Le déploiement bénéficie d'une subvention publique de quarante millions. Plus de dix mille foyers disposent encore d'une connexion très lente. Les habitants pourront choisir entre plusieurs fournisseurs d'accès sur le nouveau réseau. Les travaux dans les rues seront annoncés village par village.
paraphrase: By the end of next year, every village in the province will be connected to fibre broadband, according to the telecom operator. A public grant of forty million is helping to fund the rollout. Over ten thousand households are still stuck with very slow internet. On the new network, residents will have a choice of several providers. Street works will be announced for each village in turn.
independent_same: Mobile phone coverage remains poor in parts of the countryside, a consumer survey finds. Many residents cannot make calls inside their homes. Operators blame planning rules that slow down the building of new masts. The regulator wants to oblige operators to share infrastructure. Results of a new coverage map will be published in spring.
independent_other: Une bibliothèque rurale prête désormais des routeurs mobiles aux habitants mal connectés. Les appareils peuvent être empruntés pour deux semaines. L'initiative vise surtout les familles avec enfants scolarisés. La demande dépasse déjà largement le nombre d'appareils disponibles. La commune envisage d'en acheter davantage.

subject: food bank demand
source: The local food bank says demand has risen by a quarter compared with last year. More working families are now asking for help with groceries. Donations from supermarkets have fallen at the same time. The food bank is looking for new volunteers and storage space. It has launched a collection in schools before the winter holidays.
translation: La banque alimentaire locale indique que la demande a augmenté d'un quart par rapport à l'an dernier. De plus en plus de familles qui travaillent demandent de l'aide pour leurs courses. Dans le même temps, les dons des supermarchés ont diminué. La banque alimentaire cherche de nouveaux bénévoles et un espace de stockage. Elle a lancé une collecte dans les écoles avant les vacances d'hiver.
paraphrase: Requests to the local food bank are up by a quarter on last year, it reports. A growing number of families with jobs now need help buying food. Meanwhile, supermarkets are donating less. New volunteers and more storage room are needed, the food bank says. Ahead of the winter holidays, it has started a collection drive in schools.
independent_same: A social supermarket will open in the town next month for households on low incomes. Customers will pay about a third of the normal price for food and hygiene products. Access will be granted through the social services. The shop will be run by an association with paid staff and volunteers. Cooking workshops will also be offered.
independent_other: Des étudiants ont créé une épicerie solidaire sur le campus universitaire. Les produits sont vendus à prix coûtant aux étudiants en difficulté. Le projet est soutenu par l'université et plusieurs producteurs locaux. L'épicerie est ouverte trois soirs par semaine. Les organisateurs souhaitent ajouter des produits frais.

subject: historic bridge restoration
source: The town's historic stone bridge will be closed to traffic for a year of restoration work. Engineers found serious cracks in two of the arches during an inspection. Pedestrians and cyclists will be able to cross on a temporary footbridge. The restoration will respect the original materials and building techniques. The bridge is more than three hundred years old.
translation: Le pont de pierre historique de la ville sera fermé à la circulation pendant un an de travaux de restauration. Lors d'une inspection, les ingénieurs ont découvert de graves fissures dans deux des arches. Les piétons et les cyclistes pourront traverser par une passerelle provisoire. La restauration respectera les matériaux et les techniques de construction d'origine. Le pont a plus de trois cents ans.
paraphrase: For a year, cars will not be able to use the town's old stone bridge while it is restored. An inspection revealed that two of its arches are badly cracked. A temporary footbridge will let people on foot and on bikes get across. Original materials and traditional building methods will be used for the repairs. The bridge was built over three centuries ago.
independent_same: Traffic jams have grown in the town since the new shopping centre opened. Delivery lorries often block narrow streets in the old quarter. The council is studying a new route for heavy vehicles. Traders ask for more short-term parking. A traffic survey will be carried out this autumn.
independent_other: Des bénévoles restaurent un ancien moulin à eau classé monument historique. Ils ont déjà remis en état la roue et une partie du mécanisme. Le moulin pourra à nouveau moudre du grain lors des journées du patrimoine. Les travaux sont financés par des dons et une subvention régionale. L'association cherche des menuisiers bénévoles.

subject: community garden on a rooftop
source: A community garden has opened on the roof of a city car park. Residents can rent small plots to grow vegetables and herbs. The garden also includes beehives and a rainwater collection system. A gardening association will offer free workshops for beginners. The city hopes to create similar gardens on other public buildings.
translation: Un jardin partagé a ouvert sur le toit d'un parking de la ville. Les habitants peuvent louer de petites parcelles pour cultiver des légumes et des herbes aromatiques. Le jardin comprend aussi des ruches et un système de récupération d'eau de pluie. Une association de jardiniers proposera des ateliers gratuits pour les débutants. La ville espère créer des jardins semblables sur d'autres bâtiments publics.
paraphrase: On top of a city car park, a shared garden has just opened. Local people can rent a small plot and grow herbs and vegetables. There are beehives too, as well as a system that collects rainwater. Beginners can attend free workshops run by a gardening association. Similar gardens are planned on other public buildings if the city has its way.
independent_same: Allotment waiting lists in the city have grown to more than three years. Demand rose sharply after the pandemic, when many people discovered gardening. The council is looking for new land in parks and on school grounds. Some residents share their private gardens with neighbours. A new allotment site will open next spring.
independent_other: Une ferme urbaine produit des salades et des champignons dans une ancienne cave de brasserie. La culture se fait sans terre, sous éclairage LED. Les produits sont vendus aux restaurants du quartier. Le fondateur veut montrer qu'on peut cultiver en ville toute l'année. Des visites sont organisées pour les écoles.
